method.scope: Posthoc TRAIN-only diagnostic at fixed unadapted G0; all sites, including padding, retained

method.demand: r = G0 * d(per-patch loss)/dG0;128 channels retained separately
method.attributes: A is measurement applicability, not vessel presence or a veto; B is boundary rank ambiguity

method.zAB: Fixed normalized CT-predicted A times CT-predicted B

units.first_variation: -M*128*mean_channel_spatial(r*delta)/FIT_delta_RMS; per-patch derivative already restored, no further factor2

limitations: These are first-order local loss-direction measurements, not achieved loss, Dice, clDice or clinical improvements.
Positive r dot delta means a negative-delta gain step has negative first-order loss variation; finite-step benefit is untested.
All four fixed OLS models and both patch strata remain reported; no feature, threshold, support or ridge search.
The previously trained backbone has seen TRAIN; fixed probe cases and patches have been reused for development.
Overlapping patches are not independent cases; the12 probe cases are not verified independent patients.
The fraction of ordinary gradient energy at exactly zero G0 activations is descriptive, not an unfreezing or architecture gate.
Demand energy uses G0-multiplied derivatives; operating-space gradient energy uses ordinary derivatives and a different denominator.
